consequence.statement: Environments relying on MTU auto-detection may get a different (lowest across external interfaces) MTU than before, when multiple external interfaces exist.
consequence.remediation: Verify the detected MTU, or set MTU explicitly via the MTU helm option, --mtu agent flag or mtu CNI option.

assertion.statement: MTU auto-detection now uses the lowest MTU of all external interfaces instead of only the primary interface (secondary ENI interfaces excluded); manual MTU configuration still works.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for protocol-behavior behavior-changed
